case.title: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH. Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement. Need: 20000 pc a year. Category goal: routine: fewer suppliers and less process cost. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 7 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200004. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70620.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are delighted to assist Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and remain eager to serve all your requirements from our extensive product range.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

To give you complete visibility into our underlying costs, please note that LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost. 

As your trusted partner, we pride ourselves on exceptional distributor service and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
move.body:
Dear Florian Gruber,

Thank you for your quote and cost transparency; we recognise the cost increases you have identified. Our analysis supports a lower price within a straightforward multi-year arrangement for this standard item.

Our demand forecast for this part has changed +4.2% (fc:360020@2026-09).

The longer agreement provides a clearer planning horizon while keeping the commercial package simple. We are flexible on payment terms, including an option retaining your proposed terms; please choose whichever package works best for you.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 4.49 per unit, payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement.
Option B: EUR 4.43 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24-month agreement.
Option C: EUR 4.45 per unit, payment 45 days net, 24-month agreement.

Which volume or contract length would let you improve the price further?

We look forward to continuing our business on clear, practical terms.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your response and the proposed options. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. That does not change our position. 

Our offer features a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. As an alternative, we are prepared to agree to a 24-month contract with 30 days net payment terms, which allows us to offer a revised price of €4.88 per unit, alongside a contract term of 24 months and Zahlungsziel 30 days net. 

Regarding your question, this extended contract length is the basis for our price improvement, and further adjustments would require significantly higher volumes. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? 

Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
move.body:
Dear Florian Gruber,

Thank you for improving your offer on the basis of an extended agreement. We recognise that you need substantially higher committed volume to justify further price reductions.

We have modestly raised our price proposal and are flexible on contract length; Option B offers a longer commitment in exchange for a further price concession from you. While this does not replace the higher volume you requested, it extends your planning horizon within a simple supply arrangement—which contract length works best for you? We can commit to over 24 months, as set out in the term sheets.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 4.52 per unit, 24-month agreement, payment 90 days net.
Option B: EUR 4.52 per unit, 36-month agreement, payment 90 days net.

We appreciate your consideration of these revised packages.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We note your preference for a longer planning horizon and can accommodate a 36-month agreement. However, an extended contract length alone does not enable further price reductions; this would require a binding commitment to significantly higher volumes. Which volume can you commit to? Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.

Our current offer stands at a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Consequently, we must maintain our price at €4.94 per unit for the 36-month term with 90 days net payment. 

Alternatively, with a contract term of 36 months: a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months.

Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
move.body:
Dear Florian Gruber,

Thank you for accommodating a longer agreement; we recognise that a price reduction requires higher committed volume, not duration alone. Our basis remains expected demand, rather than a confirmed increase in committed purchases.

We have modestly raised our price proposal and expect a price concession in return, within a simple standard-supply package. We remain flexible on contract length; Option B provides the longer planning horizon, so please indicate which option works best.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 4.58 per unit, 24-month agreement, payment 90 days net.
Option B: EUR 4.58 per unit, 36-month agreement, payment 90 days net.

We appreciate your consideration and welcome a clear proposal for the required commitment.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership with Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH. We always value our business relationship and are keen to keep supporting Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH with our extensive range and high-level service.

We have already taken that volume change data into account. As we established, a price reduction requires a binding commitment to significantly higher volumes, not just expected demand. Consequently, we must maintain our price at €4.94 per unit for a 24-month agreement with 90 days net payment. 

Please note that this is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Furthermore, our Angebot stays valid for 7 days. Our commercial terms remain a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
